outcome: Pregnancy hypertension (including gestational hypertension, pre-eclampsia and eclampsia)
cohort: 1,076,122 deliveries in New South Wales, Australia, from 2001 to 2012
finding: The declining rates of pregnancy hypertension in Australia can be partly attributed to the increasing trend of early planned deliveries, despite an increase in maternal risk factors for hypertension.
gest_age: Analysis of gestational age distributions showed declining pregnancy hypertension rates from 38 weeks gestation and were steepest from 41 weeks.
